capabilities_done: Instance expansion (src/native.rs expand_instance): a document INSTANCE keeps its component_instance binding layer + SCIN record (unchanged) and gets an expansion group layer as its following sibling: the instance fill as background, then the definition (SYMBOL) children walked with the overrides mapped onto them. Mapped override fields: name, visible, opacity, fills (text runs carrying the node fills follow), characters (runs reset to the first style; >1 style = typed loss), root size (= the instance's own stored size), derivedSymbolData transform/size/derivedTextData. Every other overridden field is a typed loss per field (native.instance.expansion.override.<field> override_field_unsupported; fixture: textData.lines x1); sublayer size override without a derived entry, derived size change on a shape with geometry, uniform scale != 1, unmatched override paths are typed losses. Nested instances expand recursively (outer overrides win). Expanded nodes are recorded with Figma's guid path (NativeProposal.expanded: instance + path [I, ..., node]); their duplicated definition losses carry the prefix expansion:

Hostile bounds, refused before any layer is created: instance cycle (instance_cycle_refused), nesting > MAX_INSTANCE_DEPTH 16, override path > MAX_OVERRIDE_PATH 16, expansion cost > MAX_EXPANDED_NODES 20000 or the caller's Folio node budget left after the document's own nodes (cost walk over node indices only, 2 nodes counted per node)

Frame fills -> background layers: FRAME/SECTION/SYMBOL/instance with fills gets a bottom-most vector child of its decoded fill geometry (rounded corners resolved; else the size rectangle) carrying the fill rows; strokes stay on the frame (NativeProposal.frame_backgrounds)

Frame clipping -> clip content: frameMaskDisabled=false with children -> StudioVectorClip (NONZERO) whose source is the background (a hidden clip-source vector layer when the frame has no fill) attached to every child layer (merged with mask attachments); frame_clip_not_mapped loss removed

Text outputs: text layers record lines and runs from Figma's stored layout (decoder now reads derivedTextData baselines/glyph sizes/font keys and derivedSymbolData); resolve_text_outputs (src/text_out.rs) maps each run's family/style to a caller-granted hsk_studio_type::FontResource; a missing font is MissingFont{layer_id, family, style} + loss native.text.font=<family>/<style> font_not_granted, the layer is not output; text sources stay image-typed graph outputs
Graph: component_instance binding layers drawn by an expansion contribute no op and no loss; the components page now composites 8 outputs (was 0)
